title: Fixed Points and Envelope Dynamics on Credal Hyperspaces
abstract: arXiv:2510.04769v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Let $X$ be a compact metric space and consider the hyperspace $\mathscr C_X$ of nonempty weakly closed convex sets of Borel probability measures on $X$, called credal sets. These sets represent uncertainty about which probability law governs the phenomenon of interest. We equip $\mathscr C_X$ with the Hausdorff metric induced by a metric for weak convergence. Credal order intervals $[\mathcal{A},\mathcal{B}] = \{ \mathcal{P}\in\mathscr C_X: \mathcal{A}\subseteq\mathcal{P}\subseteq\mathcal{B} \}$ are complete lattices, and every inclusion-monotone, Hausdorff-continuous self map of such an interval has least and greatest fixed points obtained as limits of iteration from $\mathcal{A}$ and $\mathcal{B}$. For families of inclusion-monotone updates that may vary with time, we construct lower and upper envelope maps that bound every admissible trajectory. translated_title: 信度超空间上的不动点与包络动力学
translated_abstract: 设 $X$ 为紧度量空间，考虑由 $X$ 上博雷尔概率测度的非空弱闭凸集构成的超空间 $\mathscr C_X$，称为信度集。这些集合表示关于哪种概率规律支配所研究现象的不确定性。我们用由弱收敛度量诱导的豪斯多夫度量来装备 $\mathscr C_X$。信度序区间 $[\mathcal{A},\mathcal{B}] = \{ \mathcal{P}\in\mathscr C_X: \mathcal{A}\subseteq\mathcal{P}\subseteq\mathcal{B} \}$ 是完备格，且此类区间上的每个包含单调、豪斯多夫连续的自映射都具有最小和最大不动点，它们可分别作为从 $\mathcal{A}$ 和 $\mathcal{B}$ 出发迭代所得的极限而得到。对于可能随时间变化的一族包含单调更新，我们构造了下包络映射和上包络映射，用以界定每条容许轨迹。当这些包络映射为豪斯多夫连续时，每条轨迹与……的距离（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文证明了信度集超空间中包含单调且豪斯多夫连续的自映射在完备格的信度序区间上存在可由迭代求得的最小与最大不动点，并为随时间变化的更新族构造了界定所有容许轨迹的上下包络动力学。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that inclusion-monotone, Hausdorff-continuous self-maps on complete lattices of credal order intervals possess least and greatest fixed points obtained by iteration, and constructs lower and upper envelope dynamics that bound every admissible trajectory for families of time-varying updates.
